translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Daawita Katamaa Yerusaalamiw Aayye Ana!
Neenoo Daawite de'eedda Arii'eela giyaa katamaw, new aayye ana! Laytsaa bollan laytsaa gujja; baalatuwaakka zaara zaaraade bonchcha.
Taani Arii'eela giyaa katamaa birokka un"etsana; unttunttu zilaalananne yeekkana. He katamay suutsay kammeedda yarshshiyaa sa'aa mala gidanawaa.
Taani ne yuushshuwaan dooddananne adussa gimbbiyaan neena dirana; ne bollan olaa maammaa kees's'ana.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, neeni biittaa c'iimmuwaappe haa pude haasayana; hirkki baanaappe ne kooshshay yaana. Ne kooshshay moyttilliyaa kooshshaa, biittaa giddoppe kesana; ne haasayaykka baanaa giddoppe saasukettana.
Shin ne morkketuu liik'o baana keeshshaa c'oranne ne mek'etsi baynawanttu payduukka c'arkkuu afiyaa suullaa keeshshaa daro gidanawaa. K'oppennaan de'ishshin ellekka,
Ubbaappe Wolk'k'aama Med'inaa Goday guuguntsaan, biittaa k'aatsan, wolk'k'aama kooshshaan, gotiyaan, c'arkkuwaaninne miyaa tamaa lac'uwaan hinttena s'omoosana.
Arii'eela katamaa oliyaa c'ora kawutetsaa ubbay, he katamaanne Aa geessuwaa oliyaa ubbay, Aa waayissiyaa ubbay akumuwaadan, k'amma sas'aadan hanana.

Koshateedda Asay akumuwaan mee; shin beegottiyaa wode Aa koshay aggena; woy saametteedda Asay akumuwaan ushee; shin beegottiyaa wode daaburee; saamuwaakka alibeenna; S'iyoone Deriyaa oliyaa c'ora kawutetsaa ubbay hewaadan hanana.
S'oossaa Azazuwaa Kad'iyaawe Ahiyaa Muruwaa

Hintte hintterekka dammettiide, damma asaa gidite; hinttena hintterekka k'ook'issiide, k'ook'e asaa gidite. Matsottite; shin woyniyaa eessaanna gidoppo. Ganddigaarite; shin matsoyiyaa ushshaanna gidoppo.

Ayaw gooppe, Med'inaa Goday gem"ishshuwaa sonnu ootsiyaa ayaanaa hintte bollan gusseedda. Timbbitiyaa odiyaawanttoo, yaatiide hintte ayifetuwaa I goozeedda. Sas'aa be'iyaawanttoo, hintte huup'etuwaakka gulloyeedda.

Ha ubbaa sas'ay new attametteedda mas'aafaa mala gideedda. Asay, «Hey, hawaa nabbaba» yaagi, itti nabbabi danddayiyaa uraw immiyaa wode I, «Mas'aafay attametteedda diraw, taani nabbabanaw danddaykke» yaagana.
K'ay mas'aafaa nabbabi danddayenna uraw, «Hey, hawaa nabbaba» yaagiide immiyaa wode, I, «Taani nabbabanaw danddaykke» yaagana.

Yaatina, Goday hawaadan yaagana; «Hawe Asay bare bolla doonaan taakko shiik'ee; bare ins's'arssan taana bonchchee; shin unttunttu wozanay taappe haakuwaan de'ee. Unttunttu Asay med'd'eedda wogaa tamaariidde, taw c'oo goyinniino.

Hewaa diraw, be'ite, taani ha asaa bolla zaaretsaadekka maalalissiyaabaa ootsana; maalaaliyaabaanne ooratsabaa ootsana. Unttunttu eranchchatuwaa aad'd'eeda eratetsay daallamana; unttunttu akeekanchchatuwaa akeekayikka k'osettana» yaageedda.
Sintsappe Yaana Keekaa
Bare halchchuwaa c'iimmayiide, Med'inaa Godaappe k'ossiyaawanttoo, barenttu oosuwaa d'uman ootsiidde, «Nuuna ooni be'ii? Nuuna ooni erii?» yaagiyaawanttoo aayye ana!

Hintte yewotuwaa laamiitta; urk'k'aa med'd'iyaawe urk'k'aa mala giide k'oppiita! Med'etteeddawe med'd'eeddawaa, «I taana med'd'ibeenna» gaanee? Otuu barena med'd'eeddawaa, «I ayinne erenna» gaanaw danddayii?
Liibaanoosa woray aradda gadiyaw laamettanaw, aradda gadii k'ay wora gidanaw, guutsaa wodii atteeda gidenneeyye?
He gallassi tulletuu mas'aafaa k'aalaa sisana; lem"ilem"aappenne d'umaappe kesiide, k'ook'etuwaa ayfii s'eelana.
Ashkketuu gujjiidikka Med'inaa Godaan nashettana; asaa giddon de'iyaa hiyyeesatuukka Israa'eeliyaa Geeshshan hashshu gaana.
Mek'etsi bayinnawanttu wurana. K'iliic'iyaawanttu tim"i gaana. Iitabaa ootsanaw wochchiyaawanttu ubbay d'ayana.
Hewanttu yewuwaan asaa bayzzanchcha kessiyaawantta, chilootan asaa seeriyaawanttoo gitiyaa wotsiyaawanttanne wordduwaan s'illo bitaniyaa pirddaa te"iyaawantta.
Hewaa diraw, Abrahaama wozeedda Med'inaa Goday Yaak'ooba zariyaw hawaadan yaagee; «Yaak'ooba zarii hawaappe sintsanaw yeellatenna; unttunttu som"iikka yeellatiide, sa'aa s'eellenna.

Shin unttunttu ta kushiyaa ooso gidiyaa barenttu naanatuwaa barenttu giddon be'iyaa wode, ta suntsaa geeshshatetsaan naagana; unttunttu Yaak'ooba Geeshsha geeshshatetsaa bayzzikkino. Israa'eeliyaa S'oossaakka yashshatetsan bonchchana.
Ayyaanan baleeddawanttu simmiide akeekana; zuuzummiyaawanttukka timirttiyaa akkana» yaagee.
